title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap integrated with private-installer (helm + terraform)
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: automate tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private deployments so that installer (helm) and infra provisioning (terraform) can create the minimal roles, rolebindings, and service accounts needed for tenant isolation during install and upgrades. This PR wires together three pieces: 1) Helm chart hooks and templates shipped with private-installer to create RBAC manifests at install/upgrade time; 2) a small terraform module that operators can use to provision cluster-level resources as part of infrastructure-as-code; 3) a bootstrap CLI script and CI e2e tests to validate least-privilege tenant creation workflows. The goal is deterministic, auditable bootstraps for new tenants with clear separation of duties and minimal cluster-admin blast radius.

Changes in this PR include: - new helm templates: charts/private-installer/templates/rbac-bootstrap.yaml (post-install hook) and charts/private-installer/templates/rbac-roles.yaml - terraform module: terraform/modules/rbac-bootstrap (main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf) exposing a toggle for managed or delegated role creation - bootstrap script: scripts/installer/bootstrap_rbac.sh used by the installer when running in "managed" mode - migration/rollback hooks: charts/private-installer/templates/rbac-migration-hook.yaml to handle upgrades that change role schemas - e2e tests: test/e2e/rbac_isolation_test.go validating tenant isolation and permission boundaries - docs: rbac-policy-bundle/README.md and charts/private-installer/README.md documenting operator steps, IAM mappings, and recommendation for KMS/HSM integration. Checklist: - [x] Helm templates implemented with post-install and post-upgrade hooks - [x] Terraform module implemented and terraform validate passing - [x] Least-privilege role templates reviewed by security - [x] Integration e2e passing in CI - [x] Documentation added and cross-linked to private-installer docs

Notes and caveats: - This PR intentionally keeps cluster-admin creation opt-in; operators running in highly-automated environments can enable managed mode, otherwise the module emits manifests for manual apply. - The terraform module outputs RBAC manifest artifacts for air-gapped installs to be applied by on-prem operators. - We add a short-lived migration path for clusters upgrading from the previous RBAC layout; the migration hook will run only when version change detected. - Follow-up work tracked in ENG-4621: add role auditing and automated regression alerts in Redwood Console.

Sophie Alvarez: Please add terraform import guidance and an example for on-prem air-gapped installs.
Maya Chen: Added outputs and README section with terraform import/example and a note about scoping for air-gapped bootstrap artifacts.
Liam O'Connor: CI failed on helm-lint initially due to hook annotations; tests were flaky in the first run. Re-ran and fixed timing in e2e setup.

Operators can choose managed mode or emit manifests for manual apply. See rbac-policy-bundle/README.md for migration and operational guidance.
